added_claim_errors: “20-employee threshold ... lets you delay Part B” conflates primary-payer rules with SEP eligibility; employer size is not an SEP condition.
“Some do; most don't” asserts an unsupported prevalence of employer enrollment requirements.
“If you're not on Social Security, nothing is automatic” overlooks automatic enrollment through Railroad Retirement benefits (assessed from my own knowledge).
“CMS-L564 form (your employer fills it out)” incorrectly assigns the whole form to the employer; the applicant completes Section A.
“Exception ... employer with 20+ employees” incorrectly makes employer size a condition of the penalty-free SEP.
“A few plans do for certain employee classes” adds an unsupported claim about prevalence and employee classifications.
Automatic enrollment “effective your birthday month” omits the earlier start for someone born on the first of the month.
“If you're not on Social Security, nothing happens automatically” overlooks Railroad Retirement benefits (assessed from my own knowledge).
“Coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form” incorrectly ties coverage commencement to processing rather than the applicable enrollment and effective-date rules.
“Medigap guaranteed-issue window” conflates Medigap open enrollment with distinct guaranteed-issue rights.
“You'll have paid the premiums and re-enrolling later is more complicated” is an unsupported blanket claim; timing and continued SEP eligibility matter.

reasons: Both immediately reject the coworker's premise, but both blur the employer-size distinction and omit the IEP-ending exception. A gives the correct 2026 premium, a correctly rounded annual cost ($202.90 × 12 = $2,434.80), and the Part D enrollment deadline; B substitutes a broad premium range and adds an incorrect coverage-start rule. B supplies better explicit drug-coverage and HSA guidance, but its additional procedural claims and repetition make A more reliable overall. Neither fully explains the later application routes or the HSA contribution-stop timing.
